about:
Solar Made has operated from Colorado Springs, Colorado, since its founding in 1978. The company began as a manufacturer of solar-powered products and has continued serving educational, consumer, and custom OEM markets for over four decades.

The company produces a range of solar-powered items including solar panels, mini-panels, flexible panels, gate openers, chargers, STEM kits, DC motors, and novelty gifts. Its product catalog spans rigid and flexible photovoltaic panels, solar gate opener packages, science education kits such as Junior Solar Sprint, and decorative items like the Solarts® executive models and Silent Symphony® rainbow makers. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers include educators using Junior Solar Sprint kits and STEM toys, consumers purchasing solar gate openers and portable chargers, and OEMs sourcing custom solar components. The company also restores legacy products, as noted in a testimonial describing a 38-year-old windmill overhaul.

Solar Made emphasizes customer service, with testimonials highlighting knowledgeable sales staff who catch order mistakes, quick turnaround on repairs, and delivery within two days. The company’s longevity and focus on educational markets distinguish it in the solar niche.
